title: Nice
blurb: Deadpan, unenthusiastic, the internet's favourite one-word review. All the humour sits in the flatness: real approval requires energy, and this deliberately supplies none, which somehow reads as funnier than genuine praise ever could. It is the correct response to anything mildly satisfying, any number that happens to end in sixty-nine, and any achievement that does not warrant the effort of a full sentence. It also works as sincere approval delivered by somebody constitutionally incapable of showing it. Understated by design, and never once improved by adding a second word. Nice.
